You can make a language model sad by adding a single vector to its hidden state.
Finding *which* vector, *where*, and *how hard* to add it is a search problem:
push too gently and nothing happens, push too hard and the model says
"tomato tomato tomato". This series turns that search into one batched
forward pass on a TPU, where every row of the batch runs its own experiment.

It is written during the TorchTPU Sprint 26H4, using Qwen3-0.6B, Hugging Face
Transformers and TorchTPU. The steering recipes and the numbers we try to
reproduce come from Avishek Biswas's
[`learn-mech-interp/03-steering`](https://github.com/avbiswas/learn-mech-interp/tree/main/03-steering)
(MIT), which serves as the answer key throughout.
